objective: Minimize expected terminal critical-path time by spending certificate-synthesis effort only where public contract structure can still soundly upper-bound the hidden evaluation scope.

why_alive: grader is deterministic end-state assertion logic
simulated app implementation is open and local
benchmark documents about 47 apps and about 500 API endpoints
private tasks start from a similar domain distribution and use the same benchmark framework but are hardened
ranking.hard_boundary: Public 600 score is not the private leaderboard score and cannot be substituted.
ranking.cheapest_decisive_falsifier: Find a first-party private-task requirement that uses an app/API/state-transition/policy semantic outside the open benchmark grammar, or prove that the private grammar itself is not bounded by the public implementation.
ranking.success_certificate: Under V3, a first-party scope proof that the hidden target is bounded by the same finite app/API/state-transition grammar, plus target-bound evaluator and resource-semantics proofs and universal workflow success over that grammar under the frozen step/tool semantics.

why_alive: questions are designed for a single unambiguous correct answer
grading uses dealbreaker-gated weighted checks with a three-judge LLM jury rather than a purely deterministic evaluator
private validation and test splits preserve published category and difficulty distributions
ranking.hard_boundary: Distributional similarity does not imply per-instance scope superset, evaluator identity, or threshold pass.
ranking.cheapest_decisive_falsifier: Construct one admissible hidden-style finance question satisfying the published methodology whose solution requires an unbounded convention, source type, or transformation absent from the proposed universal contract.
ranking.success_certificate: Under V3, a sound hidden-scope upper-bound proof plus target-bound evaluator-relation proof, resource-semantics proof, and universal success proof over the published analytical contract; no deterministic-grader shortcut.

why_demoted: two passive observations plus only 2d+1 active experiments are finite
private structural probes score unseen points
existing Brain theorem proves unrestricted functions are nonidentifiable from any finite probe transcript
ranking.wake_condition: A first-party or independently valid bound on the hidden mechanism family that makes finite active identification complete or threshold-sufficient.
